Hangzhou Zhuopu New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. (brand:CC3D)is a factory which specialized in Polymer Materials(PLA/PBAT and other biodegradable materials)，3D printer materials and 3D pen.

Our company focus on technology innovation, offer the high-quality products. Since founded, we have been cooperating with a number of well-known high schools, and we have a team of senior technician, and obtained many national patents...
FOCUSING ON 3D PRINTING MATERIALS
We specialize in producing various 3D printing materials such as PLA, ABS, PETG, and PC. We have ten automatic production lines and an annual production capacity of over 700000 rolls.
All products are produced in a dust-free environment and use imported raw materials and materials with good toughness, high precision, stable melting point, bright and durable colors.
Provide comprehensive technical support and maintenance services to respond to your needs in a timely manner.
3d Printing Materials
Professional Production Of Various 3d Printing Materials.

All products are produced in a dust-free environment and use imported raw materials and materials with good toughness, high precision, stable melting point, bright and durable colors. The diameter tolerance can reach 0.02mm. There are over dozens of colors for you to choose from, and the products have passed international environmental certifications such as ROHS.

The company will always adhere to a market-oriented approach and prioritize customer needs. We are willing to cooperate sincerely with customers and colleagues at home and abroad, and work together to seek common development.

Intellectual Property: There are 12 independent intellectual property rights, including 5 invention patents, 4 utility model patents, 3 design patents, and 2 invention patents currently under review.

Master's student in Materials Science and Engineering, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Donghua University. Engineer, long-term research on biodegradable modified materials and their products.
